sections.title: A Little Note For You
sections.body:
Dear Biwi,

On this special day, I just want you to know how much you mean to me. Every moment with you feels like a gift, and watching you grow, smile, and shine inspires me every single day.

May this new year of your life be filled with laughter, adventure, and all the love you so freely give to others — finally coming back to you.

Happy Birthday, beautiful. Here's to many more memories together.

questions.question: Does he love me?
questions.answer: More than words can ever say... infinitely and always. ❤️

questions.question: What does he love most about me?
questions.answer: Your smile, your kindness, and the way you make ordinary days feel magical.

questions.question: Will he always be there for me?
questions.answer: Always. No matter what happens, he's not going anywhere. 💍

questions.question: What's his favorite memory of us?
questions.answer: Every single one — but especially the quiet, ordinary ones with you.

questions.question: Am I his best decision?
questions.answer: The very best one. Choosing you was the easiest 'yes' of my life.
